summary.goal: Differentiate Rate My Face from default ChatGPT through authenticated cross-session state, feedback, transactions, and future provider integrations while preserving a useful free experience.

current_experiment.name: Persistent personal network retention
current_experiment.variant_b: free core plus optional paid cross-session profile, history, saved recommendations and feedback
current_experiment.success_metric: higher 7-day return rate among exposed authenticated users; secondary paid Action adoption and feedback rate

research.competitor_pattern: Public appearance/lookalike products emphasize instant results and sharing; adjacent style products increasingly add persistent history, personalized style profiles, closets/avatars, and social loops.
research.expansion_opportunity: A separate celebrity-style inspiration surface focused on opt-in style goals, saved looks and product pathways rather than identity claims; persistent Rate My Face profile can be the shared account layer.

daily_reports.summary: Implemented Stripe-hosted subscription checkout, billing portal, webhook-driven entitlements, and premium-gated persistent memory. Production activation still requires Stripe configuration verification.

Verified the personal-network OpenAPI commit deployed successfully through GitHub/Vercel status. Rate My Face now has server-backed cross-session profile, history, saved recommendations and feedback as PAID Actions. Public competitor research supports persistence/social sharing as differentiation, but Rate My Face retention, GPT usage, Associates conversion and end-to-end Stripe credit metrics remain unmeasured. OpenAPI v2.4.0 must be re-imported and a manual authenticated GPT/payment test is required.
